name: Morrowgrain Research
summary: Bashana Runetotem asks you to bring her Morrowgrain for research in Thunder Bluff. You are to try cultivating it with an Evergreen Pouch, Tharlendis Seeds and Un'Goro Soil.

sections.title: Cultivating Samples
sections.body: You need an Evergreen Pouch, a Packet of Tharlendis Seeds and two samples of Un'Goro Soil to try cultivating Morrowgrain. Bring ten Morrowgrain to Bashana Runetotem in Thunder Bluff for her research.

faq.answer: Bashana Runetotem asks you to bring her ten Morrowgrain in Thunder Bluff.

faq.q: How do I try to cultivate Morrowgrain?
faq.answer: Use an Evergreen Pouch with a Packet of Tharlendis Seeds and two Un'Goro Soil samples to try cultivating Morrowgrain.

faq.q: Where do I bring the Morrowgrain?
faq.answer: Bring the ten Morrowgrain to Bashana Runetotem in Thunder Bluff.
